QuestInfo.name: [Cake vs. Pie] The King of Desserts
QuestInfo.0: Cakes! Pies! Two of the tastiest treats ever! But which can truly be called the king of desserts?
QuestInfo.1: Chose a side, cakes or pies, and team up to wipe out the delicious monsters appearing all over Maple World. Earn a new power by building your score.
